questions.stem_text:
The notion that there are three major life tasks - friendship, occupation, and love - is
MOST consistent with the philosophy of:

options.A: too little curvature of the cornea and lens
options.B: too much curvature of the retina and lens
options.C: too much curvature of the cornea and lens
options.D: too much curvature of the iris and cornea
options.E: incorrect alignment of the cornea and retina

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - too much curvature of the cornea and lens

questions.stem_text:
Quasi-experimental designs are distinguished from true experimental designs on the basis
of whether there is

options.A: implementation of the intervention by the researcher
options.B: pre-determined assignment of participants to groups
options.D: use of multiple measures of outcome
options.E: use of a single group of participants

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - implementation of the intervention by the researcher

questions.stem_text: Identify the only construct that is not pertinent to developmental models on intelligence:
